endpoint.description: Gateway address. Either bare HOST:PORT, http(s)://..., or ws(s)://...

token.description: JWT bearer token, appended to ws URL as ?token=...

timeout.description: Per-turn assistant_done timeout in seconds (evaluatee side). Bounds how long the driver waits for the evaluatee to finish replying after each 'send' action from the host agent.

auto_approve_tools.description: If true, automatically approves any approval_required messages from the evaluatee.

notes: v2.0: long-lived stdin/stdout JSON protocol. Spawned ONCE per scenario; the host evaluation-expert agent (acting as the customer simulator with its OWN LLM) drives turns by writing {"action":"send",...} / {"action":"end",...} lines to the driver's stdin and reads {"event":"ready"} / {"event":"evaluatee_turn",...} / {"event":"trace_written",...} / {"event":"error",...} lines on stdout. The legacy 'max_turns' and 'simulator_timeout' fields have been removed: the per-scenario hard cap now comes from min(test_case.turn_budget.hard_max_turns, evaluation_context.global_turn_cap), and there is no simulator subprocess to time out (the simulator is the host agent itself, NOT a subprocess). Reuses ws_client.py untouched.
